## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `uv run pytest` passes / Testes adicionados ou atualizados
- [ ] Lint, format and types pass (`ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy packages`)
- [ ] Docs updated (PT-BR and EN where applicable) / Documentação atualizada
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real hostnames or personal data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Plugin hashes updated if plugin files changed (`audidash plugins hash`) and `audidash plugins validate plugins` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] I only tested against systems I own or am authorized to audit / Testei apenas em sistemas autorizados
